items.title: FDA Approves First mRNA Flu Vaccine in Win for Moderna After Arduous Review
items.summary: The Food and Drug Administration approved  Moderna’s  mRNA-based flu vaccine Wednesday for adults ages 50 and older, clearing the first shot of its kind after a review process that nearly collapsed in February.  The vaccine, called mFlusiva, uses the same messenger RNA technology as Moderna’s Covid-19 shots.  It could reach pharmacies in time for the coming flu season, which typically starts in the fall.
